summary: Global threat level: High. SAGE expects about 19 countries to see deadly fighting in December and about 2 to be at full-scale war, more than in 84% of months since 1989.
Most likely to see full-scale war in December: Ukraine (93%), Yemen (45%).
Among countries below the fighting mark last month, the highest chance of deadly fighting in December: Afghanistan (60%), Niger (58%), Colombia (34%).
Most tense between countries not already fighting: Ethiopia–Eritrea, Saudi Arabia–Yemen, United States of America–Ukraine.
Highest chance of new clashes between countries in the next six months: Ethiopia–Eritrea (21%), Israel–Yemen (9%), Tajikistan–Kyrgyzstan (5%).
No build-up alerts right now: no country shows the pattern of news that came before past wars.
